actions-list.actionItem: The Speaker announced that the House do now adjourn pursuant to clause 13 of Rule I. The next meeting is scheduled for 9:00 a.m. on August 13, 2026.

The House received a message from the Senate. The Senate passed S. 289, S. 434, S. 494, S. 850, S. 1525, S. 1838, S. 2398, S. 2542, S. 2666, S. 2677, S. 3266, S. 3897, S. 3977, S. 4472, S. 4850, H.R. 1276, H.R. 2069, H.R. 2196, H.R. 5334 amended, H.R. 5366, and H.R. 6500 amended.
The Chair led the House in reciting the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.
Pursuant to clause 13 of Rule I, the Journal of the last day's proceedings was approved.
Today's prayer was offered by Rev. John Kellogg, Christ Church Capitol Hill, Washington DC.
The Speaker designated the Honorable Virginia Foxx to act as Speaker pro tempore for today.
The House convened, starting a new legislative day.
